title: i will not promote: Student, built a desktop app solo, 28 signups and stuck. How do you market on basically no budget?
content: Update: posted again today and got 35 more signups in a day, so about 60 now. A lot of the early drop-off was setup bugs I’ve since fixed, so I’m less worried about “does anyone want this” and more about “how do I reach the right people consistently
